theme: Indian Maximalism (Craft, Kitsch, Heritage & Gen AI Fusion)
aesthetic_archetype: Indian Maximalism — Lacquer Red, Turmeric Ochre, Rickshaw Emerald, Rani Pink & Mirror Gold
archetype_rationale: Infuses Sangya Tyagi's academic persona (PhD Gen AI & Media researcher) with bold Delhi street aesthetics: Delhi Haat bird's-eye market stalls, auto-rickshaw typography and stripes, swinging jhumka earrings, ornate jali lattice borders, and rich Hindi-English editorial accents.

accessibility.text_contrast: Minimum 4.8:1 for body copy (#FFF8E7 / #E0C8B0 on #140608 and #220A0E)
accessibility.testing_attributes: Every tab, button, input, dropdown item, and gallery card must have kebab-case data-testid (e.g., data-testid='nav-tab-resume', data-testid='contact-submit-button', data-testid='alter-ego-dropdown-art')

instructions_to_main_agent: Template is farm-ts (FastAPI backend + Vite React 19 frontend). Ensure all frontend routes in App.tsx render with rich seeded content even if backend is offline.
Install no extra fonts: use pre-bundled @fontsource-variable/playfair-display, @fontsource-variable/lora, and @fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans in index.css.
Implement the 5 top tabs: Home, Resume, Research, Alter Ego (Dropdown: Art, Photography, Illustrations), and Contact Me with active tab indicator.
Alter Ego dropdown MUST use Shadcn DropdownMenu or custom smooth hover/click reveal with data-testid='alter-ego-menu-trigger'.
Build the Contact enquiry form to post to /api/enquiries with Pydantic model + motor MongoDB save, showing Sonner toast on success.
Integrate Indian Maximalist visual motifs (Jhumka earring vector animations, Delhi Haat market stall cards, Auto-rickshaw green/yellow badges, marquee ribbons, mirror embroidery effects).
Ensure high contrast: text is always warm cream (#FFF8E7) against deep lacquer crimson/black (#140608, #220A0E) with bright Marigold (#F59E0B) and Rani Pink (#EC4899) accents.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.design_philosophy: Embrace Indian Maximalism fearlessly — layers of ornament, rich lacquer tones, intricate borderwork, and witty auto-rickshaw typography paired with serious academic rigor.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing_rule: Generous internal container padding (p-6 to p-12) to prevent border collisions.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_generic_slop: Never default to sterile SaaS blues or plain gray cards. Every card has an ornate header border or subtle corner filigree.
